'''Sand levitation''' was a [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] technique that used sand that naturally occurred in the [[Gelviddis Cluster/Legends|Gelviddis Cluster]] to make images like [[Hologram/Legends|holos]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] heard of it when [[Callista Ming]] showed her the different toys used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the rogue sect to train the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]].
